context: Ren and Mei discuss a translated book.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (博士/研究所/証明/単語/翻訳) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この本、翻訳がすごく自然だね。
lines.en: This book's translation is very natural.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 訳者は、言語学の博士なんだって。
lines.en: The translator is a linguistics doctor, I hear.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 難しい単語も、分かりやすいね。
lines.en: Even hard words are easy to understand.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究所で、長く翻訳を学んだそうだよ。
lines.en: They studied translation at an institute for years.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 言葉の力って、証明されてるね。
lines.en: The power of words really is proven, isn't it.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一つの単語に、深い意味があるよね。
lines.en: A single word holds deep meaning.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翻訳って、研究所の仕事みたいね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 博士の苦労が、本に表れてるね。
lines.en: The doctor's effort shows in the book.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
